An '''electrified grappling hook''' or '''electro grappling hook''', was a wrist mounted electrified hook that was shot with a single button mounted on the wrist mounted system. Then, with a second button, the hook was electrified with a powerful charge of electricity.

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fordo]] used it on [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] during the attack on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Fordo hit Durge directly in the forehead and electrocuted him. Although Durge broke the connection, which threw Fordo back and left him vulnerable, General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to break free of Durge and temporarily defeated him.
